title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file (5 failures on .moeb/README.md)
description: Five consecutive patch_file calls on .moeb/README.md failed with 'error applying hunk #1. The diff context lines may not match the current file content'. Root cause: the {{signal_id}} template variable in line 203 of README.md was expanded to an empty string during diff rendering, causing context mismatch. Additionally, a blank-line restoration attempt applied (218→218 lines) without net effect. All failures were recovered by switching to write_file for the README.
proposed_resolution: Investigate and fix the patch_file tool call path to avoid template-expanding {{...}} sequences inside diff content before hunk context matching. The expansion corrupts context lines that legitimately contain {{...}} strings (e.g., README rows describing skill template variables). Fix should either: (a) disable template expansion on diff strings passed to patch_file, or (b) document that write_file is preferred for README registration when prior rows contain template syntax.

title: spec.skill.md README link phase should prefer write_file over patch_file
description: The Phase 5 README link instruction uses patch_file with a minimal unified diff. When any line near the insertion point contains {{...}} template syntax, the kernel expands those sequences before hunk context matching, causing repeated patch failures. Switching the README link phase to use write_file (read full file, insert row, write back) would eliminate this failure mode entirely and reduce mean iteration_count for the readme-link step.
proposed_resolution: Update spec.skill.md Phase 5 to instruct the agent to use read_file followed by write_file for README registration, rather than patch_file. This eliminates the template-expansion context mismatch failure mode at the cost of larger write payloads for the README file.

title: Blank-line insertion via patch_file with zero-context hunk silently misfires
description: A patch_file call with @@ -204,0 +205,1 @@ and a single empty + line reported success (218→218 lines) but did not insert the blank line into the file. This silent failure is not surfaced as a tool error and could cause undetected formatting corruption in future runs.
proposed_resolution: Investigate patch_file handling of zero-context pure-insertion hunks that insert blank lines. The tool should either correctly insert the blank line or return an error result rather than reporting success with an unchanged line count.
